record_scope_reconstruction: Iranian suspension concerns three named official crossings, with Bashmakh reopening first and Parwezkhan/Haji Omaran later.

source_checks.finding: Original report names all three crossings and 15 October closure while recording Iranian spokesperson disagreement.
2 January story identifies the remaining two as Parwezkhan and Haji Omaran; Bashmaq had already reopened.
25 October report attributes Bashmaq restoration for people and trade to Iranian consulate.
